name: spomky-labs/access-control-bundle
description: Integration of the Access Control library into the Symfony full-stack framework.

suggest.symfony/expression-language: Required to use the expression voter and expression-based policies
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: Required to reroute the authorization features of SecurityBundle to this bundle
suggest.symfony/security-core: Required to declare workflow guards, FrameworkExtension refusing them without it even though this bundle replaces the guard listener
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: Required to use the is_granted() and access_decision() template functions
suggest.symfony/web-profiler-bundle: Required to inspect the decisions in the profiler
